blockers.label: Resend 7-day onboarding with exam merge tags
blockers.note: DEFERRED to Week 2 (2026-05-25). For Week 1, all signups get personal founder emails from Dave instead — templates at cipher-marketing/07-founder-1to1-emails.md (Day 0 / Day 3 / Day 6). Decision rationale: at <25 activated users, founder-touch outperforms any drip on signal-quality + testimonial-yield + brand loyalty. Building Cloud Function infra (functions/package.json + resend SDK + first-time deploy from this repo) was estimated 2-3h with non-trivial risk to existing 50+ deployed functions. Tradeoff was clearly not worth it pre-launch. Brad will surface founder-email recommendations during morning briefings (matched to day-since-signup + activation status).

decisions.why: Multi-criteria scoring; disagreed with MARKETING-PLAN §4.4 on Sec+ priority

decisions.what: $2/day paid cap; gate at 25 activated users

decisions.why: Original target assumed paid acquisition at $45/day

decisions.what: Day 2 email reframed around "Exam Lens" (single umbrella term across all certs, replaces cert-specific names in marketing copy)
decisions.why: Confirmed by Dave; departure from MARKETING-PLAN §9.2 literal text

decisions.what: Cornerstone blog holds for Monday 2026-05-18 — NOT publishing early
decisions.why: Publishing today breaks the week-1 social drumbeat that anchors on the cornerstone-launch beat

decisions.what: Tier 1 LPs (PMP, Sec+, SHRM-CP) built as React components + signup pre-select wiring
decisions.why: Shipped as two PRs: cipher#6 (LP components/routes) + cipher#7 (login ?exam= reader). Both must merge for message-match to work end-to-end. Dave reviews + merges + runs deploy-web.sh.

decisions.what: Deferred Resend onboarding drip automation to Week 2. Week 1 uses manual founder 1:1 emails (templates in cipher-marketing/07-founder-1to1-emails.md).
decisions.why: At <25 activated users, founder emails > automation. Functions infrastructure was partially gitignored in this repo (package.json missing, deploy script excludes functions) — 2-3h work with risk of breaking 50 deployed functions. Not worth it pre-launch.

decisions.what: Week 1 (2026-05-18 → 05-22) is PMP-only. Security+ and SHRM-CP drafts deferred to Weeks 2 and 3.
decisions.why: Concentration over spread. 6 posts across one exam cluster gives a cleaner signal on which hook converts (tool-builder vs why-B-is-a-trap vs domain-weights) than 6 posts fragmented across 3 audiences. Once we see what works for PMP, we replicate the winning hook structure for Sec+ in Week 2 and SHRM-CP in Week 3. Also lower cognitive load on a solo founder running first-week ops.

decisions.what: Locked Week 1 posting times: LinkedIn 08:00 ET (12:00 UTC), X 09:00 ET (13:00 UTC), Mon/Wed/Fri.
decisions.why: LinkedIn 08:00 ET catches working-professional pre-work scroll across all US time zones (mid-morning Central, early West Coast). X 09:00 ET stays in same morning window for cross-channel reinforcement without exact-minute duplication. Same time slot all three days = clean A/B on hook variation while holding timing constant.

decisions.what: All 6 Week 1 PMP drafts flipped draft → scheduled in posts.json.
decisions.why: Copy reviewed for voice (no first-person exam-taking, no 'cadence', max one 'cipher' pun per asset — none of the 6 used the pun). Hooks differentiated across the three days. Ready for Dave's final voice sign-off before publish.
